column1: 5.5.4.2.9.12 Manage Filters. When user clicks on this menu item a GUI, as shown in
Figure 5.75, shall be displayed. User shall check a filter type (Track Status, Scan Type,
Receiver Type etc.,) and click on ‘Apply’ option to enforce those filter categories or shall
uncheck a filter type & click on ‘Apply’ option to remove those filters categories on SCD
